Spacing era Curry's Warriors made mandatory.

How Three-point revolution connects

  • Character: Stephen Curry — Stephen Curry's Warriors made the three-point revolution league-wide.
  • Faction: Golden State Warriors — The three-point revolution was proven on the Golden State Warriors.

What is Three-point revolution?

The three-point revolution is the offensive shift that followed Stephen Curry's Warriors: more threes, more spacing, and a league that stopped treating the arc as a gimmick.

Key threads lead to Stephen Curry and Golden State Warriors.
